title: Unable to upload data to mongo Attempt to invoke virtual method 'int.java.lang.Object.hashCode()' on a null object reference
body:
### Your environment
- Nightly 38fee03-2021.03.31
- Mongodb v4.4.4 running on debian 10

### Expected behavior
I expect being able to sync insulin and bg data to mongo. I'd guess there's some erroneous reading that makes the uploader queue fail. 

### Actual behavior
1. Uploader successfully connects and auths
1. Data is not sent.
1. Log shows
    ```
    NightscoutUploader
    Unable to upload data to mongo Attempt to invoke virtual method 'int.java.lang.Object.hashCode()' on a null object reference
    ```

### Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. View logs
2. See above error
3. Wait 5 minutes
4. Loop to 1.


mongod.log
```
{"t":{"$date":"2021-04-06T14:11:23.811+00:00"},"s":"I",  "c":"NETWORK",  "id":22943,   "ctx":"listener","msg":"Connection accepted","attr":{"remote":"127.0.0.1:43006","connectionId":164395,"connectionCount":5}}
{"t":{"$date":"2021-04-06T14:11:24.270+00:00"},"s":"I",  "c":"ACCESS",   "id":20250,   "ctx":"conn164395","msg":"Successful authentication","attr":{"mechanism":"SCRAM-SHA-1","principalName":"xdrip","authenticationDatabase":"admin","client":"127.0.0.1:43006"}}

{"t":{"$date":"2021-04-06T14:16:18.590+00:00"},"s":"I",  "c":"ACCESS",   "id":20250,   "ctx":"conn164396","msg":"Successful authentication","attr":{"mechanism":"SCRAM-SHA-1","principalName":"xdrip","authenticationDatabase":"admin","client":"127.0.0.1:43102"}}
```

I downgraded to e14bae1-2020.07.13 with same issue, but couldn't get uploader queue to clear. Same issue.

Thanks in advance

comments.body: Upload to mongodb is not supported, anymore (see #1502).
